user.title: Delivery Tracker
user.description: Give the integration a name. Mailboxes, destinations and API sources are added afterwards.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for {source} were rejected. Please enter the current password or API key.

error.folder_not_found: The folder does not exist or cannot be opened.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the log for details.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Delivery Tracker is already set up.
abort.reauth_unknown_source: The affected source no longer exists.

user.title: Add mailbox
user.description: Credentials of the IMAP mailbox. The connection is tested before saving.

data_description.port: Leave empty for the default port (993 for SSL/TLS, otherwise 143).
data_description.verify_ssl: Only disable for servers with a self-signed certificate.

reconfigure.title: Edit mailbox
reconfigure.description: Credentials of the IMAP mailbox. An empty password field keeps the stored password.

data_description.port: Leave empty for the default port (993 for SSL/TLS, otherwise 143).
data_description.verify_ssl: Only disable for servers with a self-signed certificate.

folder.title: Folder and retrieval
folder.description: Logged in to {server}. Choose the folder that receives the parcel emails.

data_description.use_idle: New emails arrive immediately if the server supports IDLE. Otherwise the folder is checked every polling interval.
data_description.lookback_days: How many days of unread emails are considered on the first retrieval.

error.cannot_connect: The server cannot be reached. Check server, port and encryption.
error.invalid_auth: The server rejects the username or password.
error.folder_not_found: The folder does not exist on the server or cannot be opened.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This mailbox with this folder is already set up.

user.title: Add destination
user.description: How to recognise a shipment for this address. All rules are optional, at least one is required. Several entries per field are alternatives, such as different spellings.

data_description.emails: "@example.com" matches the whole domain, plus aliases are recognised.
data_description.keywords: Free terms from the address line, such as a company name.

reconfigure.title: Edit destination
reconfigure.description: How to recognise a shipment for this address. Existing shipments are reassigned after saving.

data_description.emails: "@example.com" matches the whole domain, plus aliases are recognised.
data_description.keywords: Free terms from the address line, such as a company name.

error.invalid_name: This name is not allowed. "Unknown" is reserved for unassigned shipments.
error.name_exists: A destination with this name already exists.
error.no_rules: At least one rule is required, otherwise no shipment is ever assigned to this destination.

user.title: Add API source
user.description: A tracking API provides the shipment status directly from the carrier.

reconfigure.title: Edit API source
reconfigure.description: Settings for {source}. An empty key field keeps the stored key.

error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the log for details.

abort.already_configured: This source is already set up.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The API source has been updated.

init.title: Settings
init.description: Global settings for all mailboxes and sources.

data_description.retention_days: How long completed shipments stay visible. 0 keeps them indefinitely.
data_description.stale_days: Shipments without an update for this long are removed, even if they never completed. 0 disables this.
data_description.enabled_carriers: Emails from disabled carriers are not evaluated.
data_description.generic_fallback: Detects shipments from unknown carriers using general patterns.
